statement: A prepaid phone plan charges a flat fee of $\$18$ per month plus $\$0.05$ for each text message sent. Last month Imani's bill was $\$31.40$. How many text messages did Imani send last month?

choices.misconception: I subtracted the fee correctly but wrote $5$ cents as $0.5$ dollars, so I divided $13.40$ by $0.5$ and got $26.8$.
I divided the whole bill, $31.40$, by $0.05$ and forgot that $18$ dollars of it is the flat fee, not texts.
I added the flat fee to the bill instead of subtracting it, so I divided $49.40$ by $0.05$ and got $988$.

hints: Only part of the bill comes from text messages.
Write an equation with the flat fee plus $0.05$ times the number of texts equal to the bill, then solve it.
The equation is $18 + 0.05t = 31.40$, so the texts cost $31.40 - 18 = 13.40$ dollars at $0.05$ dollars each.

solutions.reliable: Let $t$ be the number of texts. Then $18 + 0.05t = 31.40$. Subtract $18$: $0.05t = 13.40$. Divide by $0.05$: $t = 268$. Check: $0.05 \cdot 268 = 13.40$ and $18 + 13.40 = 31.40$.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
